4.8 stars. 101 reviews. One bakery in An Thới that keeps showing up on every local's list.

Ryrao Bakery sits at 89 Positano An Thới, Phú Quốc. Far enough from the main tourist strip that most visitors never find it. Close enough that you have zero excuse once you know.

Fresh bakes. Solid coffee. A rating that doesn't lie.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
